verdict.reason: Verified directly: docs/tasks/active/20260917-wafflebase-doc-store-todo.md has every Task 1/2/3 checkbox unchecked ([ ]) and 'Review: _Filled in when the PR lands._' (lines 88-203), yet packages/frontend/src/lib/wafflebase-doc-store.ts (1041 lines) fully implements the DocStore over IndexedDB with compression, cleanup (dropAllForUser, collectStale, quota eviction via withQuotaRetry/evictOldest), and archive-on-remove (expectLoss/remove/listArchives/loadArchive/dropArchive) exactly as the todo describes as still-to-do. The contract suite (doc-store-contract.ts) and wafflebase-doc-store.test.ts (running it against both MemoryDocStore and WafflebaseDocStore) plus wafflebase-doc-store-{archive,atomicity,cleanup,robustness}.test.ts all exist and are substantive, not stubs. This is a real, user-facing (to future readers/agents of the task doc) documentation-vs-code contradiction squarely in the Docs lens's rubric ('Documentation contradicted by this PR's own code'). No guard or already-checked-elsewhere circumstance neutralizes it — the todo file itself is the artifact meant to track completion and it misrepresents the state of the tree.
